purpose: Define one canonical owner for each AIPS comparison, audience/use-case and budget-support intent so supporting content strengthens money pages without cloning transactional price/buy intent or creating keyword-permutation pages.

authority.rule: This file controls SEO intent routing and internal-link architecture only. It cannot create or override protected commercial/provider facts.

rules: Reuse the existing canonical support route when it already satisfies the user intent; do not create word-order or Bangladesh suffix variants solely for SEO.
Comparison pages compare only currently governed AIPS public catalog evidence and must not imply an access mode that is not currently published for the compared product.
Audience/use-case guides help users narrow a workflow and link to canonical product owners; they do not own exact product price/buy queries.
Budget pages are deterministic filters of current governed fixed-price AIPS catalog records. They are not rankings, discount claims or cheapest-in-market claims.
Support pages may link to Tier-A money pages, categories and other support owners using descriptive natural anchors; redirect-source aliases must not be used as internal destinations.
Product/Offer/AggregateRating/Review structured data does not belong on these support pages. Use WebPage/CollectionPage/BreadcrumbList semantics only where truthful.
Unknown provider features, quotas, credits, current plan entitlements, delivery, refunds, warranties, authorization and social proof remain unpublished unless separately governed.
